purpose: Non-production customer login API for the seeded UAT account used by checkout and account smoke testing.
dataOwnership: Projects valid UAT identities into production customer identity tables.
Creates real customer_sessions rows and stores only token hashes.
Profile reads are resolved from the active backend session token.
securityRules: The endpoint is disabled unless an active Spring profile is local, dev, or uat.
OTP must be exactly six digits.
